First, note the date format given is MM-DD-YYYY: 04-21-2014.  
Subtract 332 days:  

2014 is not a leap year (2014 ÷ 4 = 503.5).  
From 2014-04-21 back 21 days → 2014-03-31.  
Remaining days to subtract: 332 − 21 = 311 days.  

Go back into 2013:  
From 2014-03-31 back 365 days (full year 2013) → 2013-03-31.  
311 − 365 = −54 days, meaning we went too far back.  

Instead, subtract 311 days from 2014-03-31 directly:  
2013 is not leap year.  
From 2014-03-31 back 365 days to 2013-03-31 is 365 days, but we only need 311 days back from 2014-03-31.  

311 days before 2014-03-31:  
March 2014 has 31 days, subtract 31 → 2014-02-28 (28 days in Feb 2014).  
311 − 31 = 280 days left.  
Now from 2014-02-28 go back into 2013:  
2013-12-31 is 59 days before 2014-02-28 (31 days Jan + 28 days Feb).  
280 − 59 = 221 days left to go back from 2013-12-31.  

221 days before 2013-12-31:  
Dec: 31 days → 2013-11-30 (1 day back to Dec 30, but easier to subtract months).  
Better: 221 days before 2013-12-31:  
Back 365 days in 2013 is too much, so count months:  
221 days = 7 months + some days (since avg month ~30.44).  

Check:  
From 2013-12-31 back:  
Dec: 31 days → 2013-11-30 (30 days counted)  
Nov: 30 days → 2013-10-31 (30+30=60)  
Oct: 31 days → 2013-09-30 (60+31=91)  
Sep: 30 days → 2013-08-31
